items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 13:1
items.html: The first is that these new Hesed-Gevura [pairs], which contain the illumination of Hochma, are found to enlarge and complete the backs of ZON, as mentioned above in answer 100. And the second is that they attain the Mochin of the face, which are their GAR, whereupon they couple face-to-face. (p. 507, Item 29)
